children: European shares were subdued at open on Tuesday, as investors awaited developments on potential US-Iran talks, while oil prices gained for the first time in five sessions.

Energy stocks (.SXEP) gained 0.4% tracking a rise in oil prices as investors awaited developments on potential US-Iran talks at the United Nations General Assembly this week after more supplies emerged through the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend.
Retail shares were a bright spot, up 1.3%, boosted by gains in Kingfisher
after the European home improvement retailer raised its full-year profit guidance after reporting a 9.9% increase for the first half of the year.
On the other hand, insurance shares (.SXIP) dipped roughly 1%, pressured by losses in ASR Nederland
